summary: Tested the Teleton fullscreen modal on the home page (/) with Playwright on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). CRITICAL bug found and fixed: the modal was always invisible to users. It was rendered in the DOM but a badge-hiding CSS rule in public/index.html (div[style*="z-index: 2147483"] {display:none!important; visibility:hidden; opacity:0}) matched the modal's inline zIndex 2147483600. After excluding the modal from that selector and restarting the frontend, all checks pass: the modal shows on load with the background image and logo (both load), 'O QUE TE MOVE?', 'levar futuro' and 'Doar agora'. The CTA closes the modal and stays on / with the iframe visible. The X closes the modal too.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. The modal was hidden by the badge-hiding CSS rule in public/index.html because its inline style contained 'z-index: 2147483600'. The selector now has :not([data-testid="home-donate-modal-overlay"]).

issues: Montserrat does not seem to be loaded in the parent document (index.html only loads Nunito), so the title and CTA render in a fallback sans-serif font. Load Montserrat in index.html to match the Teleton look.

action_items: Keep the index.html fix, or set the modal zIndex to a value that doesn't contain '2147483' (e.g. 999999) and hide the mobile confirm button while the modal is open.
Optional: load the Montserrat font in public/index.html.
critical_code_review_comments: The generic badge-hiding rule div[style*='z-index: 2147483'] is fragile: it hides any app div with an inline z-index starting with 2147483. Use a more specific selector.
Changes to public/index.html need a frontend restart: the dev server kept serving the old HTML until 'supervisorctl restart frontend'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Modal flow verified on desktop and mobile: shows on load, CTA and X both close it, URL stays /, iframe home-aacd-frame visible afterwards. On mobile the modal covers mobile-confirm-donation-btn correctly.
